Assignment 2 is actively in progress—drone navigating 231.5 m toward (-1064,-842) with a 90.5 s arrival deadline at mission time 60.0 s—and remains feasible at max velocity. No pending maneuver requests. A fresh replan can preserve the in-progress assignment-2 leg, drop or replace the structurally infeasible assignment 3, and allocate the remaining 110 s+ mission time to viable observation targets under the current belief. The accepted replacement chart may preempt through Maneuver Control once published; the prior plan remains authoritative until MiniZinc and Statechart validation complete.
